verdict.rationale: Orama documents a programmatic API for its open-source library, covering database creation with a schema, insert and insertMultiple, facets, and vector and hybrid search. Orama Cloud offers official JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust SDKs, with APIs designed to mirror the open-source ones, plus an auto-configured MCP server and an llms.txt for AI consumers. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/REST spec (all probed paths returned 404), an evidenced HTTP endpoint reference for Cloud, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
